# Ai Graphics LLC

> Custom apparel, uniform store, embroidery, and commercial printing company based in Homestead, Florida.

## About Ai Graphics
[Ai Graphics](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/) is a premier custom apparel and commercial printing company located in Homestead, FL, serving Miami-Dade County (Homestead, Florida City, Cutler Bay, Kendall, and Greater Miami) and offering nationwide shipping across the US. We specialize in high-quality commercial embroidery, Direct-to-Film (DTF) printing, window graphics, perforated window film, banners, signs, and marketing promotional items.

## Contact Information
- Website: [Ai Graphics Official Website](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/) (English) · [Sitio en español](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/es)
- Phone / WhatsApp: [+1 (305) 970-5085](tel:+13059705085)

- Service Areas: Homestead, FL; Florida City, FL; Cutler Bay, FL; Kendall, FL; Miami, FL; Nationwide USA shipping.

## Core Products & Services

### 1. DTF Printing (Impresión DTF)
- [DTF T-Shirts, Long Sleeves & Hoodies](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/dtf-t-shirts-hoodies): Full-color transfers on t-shirts, long sleeves, hoodies and sweatshirts in cotton, polyester, and dry-fit fabrics.
- [DTF Work Polos & Workwear](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/dtf-work-polos): Industrial-grade shirts with durable company logo printing.
- [Hats with DTF Transfers](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/dtf-hats): Heat-press transfer printing on all styles of headwear.
- [DTF School Uniforms](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/dtf-school-uniforms): Custom graduation and school spirit wear.

### 2. Custom Embroidery (Bordado)
- [Embroidered Hats & Caps](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/embroidered-hats): Flat embroidery and 3D Puff high-relief embroidery on all styles of hats.
- [Embroidered Company Polos](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/embroidered-polos): Professional stitching on polo shirts and workwear.
- [Embroidered School Uniforms](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/embroidered-school-uniforms): Embroidered crests, badges, skirts, and vests.

### 3. Signs & Large Format (Letreros y Gran Formato)
- [Perforated Window Film (One-Way Vision)](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/perforated-window-film): Perforated vinyl for commercial storefronts and vehicle rear windows.
- [Storefront & Window Vinyl](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/storefront-window-vinyl): Storefront vinyl graphics, hours, and branding.
- [Banners & Retractable Roll-Up Stands](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/banners-retractable-stands): Portable trade show displays and outdoor banners.
- [Coroplast & PVC Signs](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/coroplast-pvc-signs): Coroplast yard signs and PVC boards with UV laminate protection.

### 4. Marketing & Promotional Products
- [Die-Cut Stickers](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/die-cut-stickers): Waterproof vinyl stickers for products, cars, and branding.
- [Business Cards](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/business-cards) & [Flyers](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/flyers): Premium cardstock business cards and marketing flyers.
- [Foam Board & PVC Displays](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/foam-board-pvc-displays): PVC and foam board / foam counter signs.
- [Mugs & Promotional Products](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/promotional-mugs): Sublimation mugs and custom glassware.

### 5. Miscellaneous
- [Aprons, Chef Hats & More](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/products/aprons-chef-hats): Custom aprons and chef hats with your business logo.

### 6. Website Design (Diseño de Páginas Web)
- [Website Design Packages](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/web-design): Presence one-page site $799 (launch promo $399.99 for the first 5 clients), Business up to 5 pages $1,499, custom sites from $2,499. Optional maintenance $39/month or $79/month.

## Turnaround & Order Policies
- Business Hours: Monday to Sunday, 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM, by appointment only (home-based workshop).
- Turnaround Time: Standard production is 3-5 business days.
- Rush Orders: Priority rush service (24-48 hours) is available with expedited rates upon request.
- Minimum Orders: Flexible on apparel and uniforms (no strict minimums). Specific minimums apply to items like stickers and business cards ([Contact Us](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/contact)).
- Local Pickup: By appointment only in Homestead (home-based workshop; message on WhatsApp before visiting).
- Shipping: Nationwide delivery available.
- FAQs: [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#faqs)
